Metre support

Answers to the questions we hear most. If yours isn’t here, write to us: a person reads every message.

Contact support

Please mention your iPhone or iPad model, your iOS version and, if you can, a screenshot. You never need to send personal data.

Email support

Accuracy

How accurate is Metre?

In good light, on a textured surface, with the point at the centre of the screen and 1–3 m away, results are often within 1–2 cm; LiDAR devices usually do better. The precision ring turns green when Metre is confident, and every saved result is marked with how precise it is.

Measurements are estimates. For cutting, ordering or building, confirm critical dimensions with a physical tape.

How do I check my phone’s accuracy?

Open Settings → Check my phone’s accuracy and measure an A4 sheet (297 × 210 mm) or a bank card. Metre compares the result with the real size and tells you how far off your phone is in that light and at that distance. It takes about 20 seconds.

The ring stays yellow or red. What should I do?

  • Move the phone slowly across the floor or table for two seconds so it can find the surface.
  • Turn on a light. Dim rooms, glass, mirrors and black fabric confuse the camera.
  • Stay 1 to 3 metres away and keep the point at the centre of the screen; turn the phone rather than looking sideways.
  • For long walls, measure in two or three parts.
  • Placed a point slightly off? Drag it to the real corner.

Devices and LiDAR

Do I need an iPhone with LiDAR?

No. Every Metre tool works with the camera alone, on any iPhone or iPad that runs iOS 17 or later. The only exception is the automatic 3D room scan, which uses Apple’s RoomPlan and requires a LiDAR scanner. On non-LiDAR devices you can still measure whole homes room by room with the Home survey.

Which devices have LiDAR?

iPhone 12 Pro and Pro Max and later Pro and Pro Max models, and iPad Pro models from 2020 onward. On these devices surfaces are found faster, dim rooms work better and results are tighter.

Settings, units and calibration

How do I switch between centimetres and inches?

Go to Settings → Units and choose metric or imperial. You can also fix a length unit (mm, cm, m, fractional or decimal inches, feet and inches, decimal feet or yards), an area and a volume unit, and the precision: 1 cm / ¼ in, 0.5 cm / ⅛ in or 1 mm / 1/16 in.

How do I calibrate the on-screen ruler and ring sizer?

Open Settings → Calibrate screen with a bank card. Place any standard bank card (85.6 mm wide) on the screen and drag the slider until the outline matches its width exactly, then save. The ruler and the ring sizer use this calibration from then on.

Can I use Metre in my language?

Metre is available in 36 languages and follows your iPhone’s language. To choose a different language just for Metre, open iOS Settings → Apps → Metre → Language (on iOS 17: Settings → Metre). The option appears once more than one language is listed in Settings → General → Language & Region.

The camera doesn’t start.

Metre needs camera access to measure. Open iOS Settings → Metre and turn on Camera, then reopen the app.

Purchases and subscriptions

How do I restore my purchase on a new device?

Sign in with the same Apple ID, open Metre and tap Settings → Restore purchases. Active subscriptions and the lifetime purchase are restored by Apple.

How do I cancel my subscription or free trial?

Open iOS Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions → Metre → Cancel Subscription, or tap Settings → Manage subscription in Metre. Cancel at least 24 hours before the trial or the current period ends to avoid the next charge. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.

I bought lifetime but still have a subscription.

Buying the lifetime option does not cancel an existing subscription automatically. Cancel the subscription as described above; your lifetime purchase keeps Pro unlocked.

How do I get a refund?

Refunds are handled by Apple. Request one at reportaproblem.apple.com. We can’t issue refunds ourselves, but we’re happy to help with any problem.

Your data

Where are my measurements stored?

In the app, on your device. Nothing is uploaded and there is no account. Your measurements are included in your iCloud or computer backup if you use one. With Metre Pro you can also export PDF, CSV, DXF or USDZ files. Deleting the app deletes its data.
